findings.issue: homeData re-implements card construction (id/name/label/sprite + dex ordering) that cardsFor at model.ts:79-95 already owns, so any change to card shape, sprite derivation or ordering must be made twice.
findings.suggestion: Extract a single card-factory (e.g. makeCard(id, name, extra)) used by both cardsFor and homeData, keeping the 'ordered by dex number' rule in one place.

findings.issue: All PokeAPI responses flow through the model as any (model.ts:48, 156, 161, 178, 188, 196-197, 270, 281, 303, 329, 333), so renaming or mis-typing an API field is invisible to the compiler while editing the transformation layer.
findings.suggestion: Declare minimal interfaces for the handful of response shapes actually consumed (species, pokemon, move, ability, type, generation) instead of any.

findings.issue: The loading/not-found fallback pattern <Show when={data()} fallback={<Show when={data() === null}><NotFound/></Show>}> is duplicated in all four detail routes (pokemon/[name].tsx:52, moves/[name].tsx:19, abilities/[name].tsx:19, types/[name].tsx:17).
findings.suggestion: Add a tiny wrapper component (e.g. <DataView data={data()}>{(d) => …}</DataView>) that owns the undefined-vs-null distinction and renders NotFound once.

findings.issue: Card carries optional per-feature fields (types?, hidden?) and PokemonCard renders each variant with Show branches (app/src/components/PokemonCard.tsx:20-25), so every new card variant widens a shared type and one component.
findings.suggestion: Either accept children/note props for per-page extras, or keep Card purely core fields and let pages pass extra content through the card component's props.

findings.issue: Each page states its heading twice: as PageTitle's heading prop and again as the literal h1 (e.g. app/src/routes/moves/[name].tsx:17-18), which can drift and must both be edited on a rename.
findings.suggestion: Have PageTitle render the h1 as well (or read the title from a single constant per page) so the text lives in one place.

findings.issue: The badge color depends on an implicit cross-file contract: tokens.css must define --type-<api name> for every type; a new type silently falls back to the muted color.
findings.suggestion: Keep the fallback but centralize the token name mapping in lib (e.g. a typeToken(name) helper) and note the convention next to the token definitions.

findings.issue: Query cache keys ('home', 'pokemon', 'pokemon-moves', 'move', 'ability', 'types', 'type') are bare string literals co-located with the queries; a typo collides silently.
findings.suggestion: Derive keys from the exported function names or define them as named constants next to the query they identify.

summary: This is a well-seamed SolidStart v2 app: all data access is quarantined behind "use server" query wrappers over a typed view-model layer, so changing the data source or a page's data is a one-file job. The main editability costs are the duplicated card construction in homeData versus cardsFor, the four-times-copied route skeleton (Show/NotFound fallback plus doubled h1 text), and an any-typed API surface inside the server model. None of these make change painful, but each turns a one-place fix into a two-or-four-place fix.
